chart.title: Transmembrane Potential Response
chart.tipMainTitle: Transmembrane Potential vs Frequency Schwan: Vm(f) = 1.5·E·R·cos(θ) / √(1+(ωτ)²) X-axis: log 10 kHz → 500 MHz · Y-axis: peak Vm Faint curves: library presets Bright curves: active cells · Band: ±σ_i uncertainty Amber dashed: Vm selectivity ratio T/H (right axis) Dotted lines: lysis threshold · Rev-EP at 50% Drag white cursor to set broadcast frequency
chart.tipReference: Reference cells Healthy baseline, hepatocyte, RBC. Higher threshold voltage, lower membrane permittivity.
chart.tipCancer: Cancer cells Larger radius → lower fc → higher Vm at low frequency. Lower threshold → disrupted at lower field intensity.
chart.tipBacteria: Bacteria Small radius (0.5-1 µm) → fc ~8-49 MHz. Thick peptidoglycan wall raises membrane thickness.
chart.tipVirus: Viruses Radius ~60 nm · Schwan fc ~0.4-0.75 kHz (σ_i-limited; ωτ >> 1 at all practical lab frequencies). Single-shell model is approximate for virions.
chart.tipActiveH: Active Healthy cell Currently selected healthy baseline (cyan, full opacity). Shows Vm curve for selected preset and current field.
chart.tipActiveT: Active Target cell Currently selected target cell (red, full opacity). Drag the white cursor to set broadcast frequency.
chart.tipVmRatio: Vm Selectivity Ratio (amber dashed · right axis) Vm_T / Vm_H, orientation-independent (cos θ cancels). >1× → target accumulates more Vm than healthy. Pulse step factor accounts for ns-pulse charging fraction.
chart.tipNucH: Nuclear Vm: Healthy (dashed, half opacity) Double-shell model (Kotnik & Miklavcic 2006). Vm_nuc bandpass peaks at f_peak = 1/(2π√(τ_out·τ_ne)). Hepatocyte: f_peak ≈ 1.66 MHz · Vm_nuc ≈ 40 mV at 417 kHz
chart.tipNucT: Nuclear Vm: Target (dashed, half opacity) Double-shell model (Kotnik & Miklavcic 2006). Cancer NE thinner/leakier → higher Vm_nuc, lower threshold. Adenocarcinoma: f_peak ≈ 0.74 MHz · Vm_nuc ≈ 110 mV
chart.tipDepH: DEP: Healthy Re[K(f)] (dotted cyan · right axis) Clausius-Mossotti factor Re[K] ∈ [−0.5, +0.5]. Re[K] > 0 → pDEP (attracted to field maxima) Re[K] < 0 → nDEP (repelled from field maxima) Re[K] = 0 → crossover frequency f_cross Single-shell sphere model (Gascoyne & Vykoukal 2002). Curve shows raw Re[K](f), waveform-independent.
chart.tipDepT: DEP: Target Re[K(f)] (dotted red · right axis) Clausius-Mossotti factor Re[K] ∈ [−0.5, +0.5]. Re[K] > 0 → pDEP (attracted to field maxima) Re[K] < 0 → nDEP (repelled from field maxima) Re[K] = 0 → crossover frequency f_cross Single-shell sphere model (Gascoyne & Vykoukal 2002). Effective force ∝ Re[K] × (0.5 for CW, dc for pulsed H-FIRE).
